name: Dindraine

attributes.attribute: gave her blood to heal a woman of leprosy

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Dindraine was an Arthurian heroine. She was the sister of PERCIVAL. This minor character was a generous woman. She gave her blood to heal a woman of leprosy.
